test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was not one of the nine priority areas of the Union Budget 2024-25 aimed at generating ample opportunities for all?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sustainable development of fisheries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The central budget for **2024-25** focused on nine priority areas aimed at creating opportunities for all. These areas were aligned with the government's vision of **inclusive growth** and economic development.
 
• While critical sectors like **employment, skills, energy security**, and **manufacturing and services** were emphasized, **“Sustainable development of fisheries”**__ was not explicitly mentioned as one of the budget’s highlighted priority areas.
 
• The nine priority areas generally focused on **infrastructure, digital transformation, green energy, and human capital development**, leaving out fisheries as a distinct focus area in this context.
 
• However, fisheries and allied sectors may still be part of broader schemes or programs under the government’s agricultural and rural development initiatives.
 
• The omission of **fisheries** as a specific priority does not undermine its importance but reflects a strategic focus on other sectors driving macroeconomic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Employment and Skill Training**__

 __
 
• The budget emphasized **employment generation** through skill development programs, particularly focusing on **youth and women.**
 
• Programs like **PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana** and initiatives for skilling in emerging technologies (e.g., AI, IoT) were highlighted.
 
 
 
• **Energy Security**__
 __
 
• Energy security was a prominent priority area in the budget, focusing on **renewable energy** projects and reducing dependency on fossil fuels.
 
• Significant investments were allocated for **green hydrogen, solar energy parks**, and **energy transition initiatives**.
 
 
 
• **Manufacturing and Services**__
 
 
• The budget aimed to boost the **manufacturing sector** through **Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes** and promote services such as IT, tourism, and finance.
 
• This focus was intended to enhance India's global competitiveness and contribute to the goal of **Aatmanirbhar Bharat.**
